name: Dongfang Electric Corporation Limited
summary: Dongfang Electric Corporation Limited, a subsidiary of Dongfang Electric Corporation, designs, produces and sells power generation equipment worldwide from its base in Chengdu. Business is arranged in five divisions: renewable energy, clean and efficient energy, engineering and trading, modern manufacturing services and emerging industries, supporting wind, solar, hydro, nuclear, gas and thermal output. Set up in 1993, it carried the name Dongfang Electric Machinery Co., Ltd. before 2007.
